4c5d1dec8d0a.title: Developer Community Engagement Intern
4c5d1dec8d0a.description_html:
About TensorWave

Our mission is simple: deliver seamless, secure, reliable, and resilient AI compute at scale. We've built a versatile cloud platform that eliminates infrastructure barriers, empowering builders to focus on innovation instead of fighting their stack. Because breakthrough AI should move at the speed of ideas, not infrastructure.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Developer Community Engagement Intern to join our team during an exciting phase of growth. In this role, you’ll help run the Wavelabs community and events as the program grows. You'll manage our developer Discord, support developer meetups and hackathons, coordinate event vendors and keep our developer content calendar on track.

You'll report to the Head of Developer Ecosystem, and work with marketing, creative and technical teams, plus partners.

What You’ll Do

Discord community management

  • Welcome and onboard new members, and keep channels organized and active

  • Answer first-line questions and route technical questions to the right engineers

  • Moderate conversations in line with community guidelines

  • Help run community activities such as polls, challenges and AMAs

  • Compile weekly community metrics (new members, active users, response times) for the Head of Developer Ecosystem

Content calendar and program support

  • Keep the developer content calendar up to date across the newsletter, blogs, social posts, webinars and event promotion

  • Draft social posts, event recaps and newsletter sections for review

  • Update project trackers and prepare weekly status updates for the Head of Developer Ecosystem

  • Assist with logistics for partner co-marketing deliverables

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a bachelor's or master's program in marketing, communications, computer science, business or a related field

  • Active in online communities such as Discord, GitHub or Reddit, with a feel for how developers talk and what they value

  • Clear, friendly and concise writing

  • Highly organized, able to juggle several events and deadlines at once

  • Comfortable with Google Workspace or Notion, Canva and the major social platforms

  • Genuine interest in AI, cloud computing or developer tools

  • Proactive and eager to learn, comfortable taking direction and following up with vendors and teammates

Internship Information

  • Paid Internship

  • May - August (12 weeks)

  • Tuesday - Friday, 8 hours

Equal Employment Opportunity

TensorWave is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected status under applicable law.

Reasonable Accommodations

TensorWave provides reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable laws. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please contact accomodations@tensorwave.com.

Employment Eligibility

All offers of employment are contingent upon verification of identity and authorization to work in the United States, as required by law.

Background Checks

Where permitted by law, employment may be contingent upon the successful completion of a job-related background check.

Data Privacy Notice

By submitting an application, you acknowledge that TensorWave may collect, use, and retain your personal information for recruiting and employment-related purposes in accordance with applicable data privacy laws.

4c834b013628.title: Device Engineer Internship / Co-op, Fall 2026
4c834b013628.description_html:
Panther: Better Health Is Skin Deep

Panther is unlocking the tremendous biological power of our skin, delivering efficacious, shelf-stable treatments directly to customers. Panther's precisely engineered smart microarray patches (SmartPatches) address a wide range of needs in Skin Health (cosmetics, medical aesthetics) and are designed to treat conditions in Systemic Health (infectious diseases, allergies, cancer, autoimmune diseases, metabolic disorders). Billions of people around the world lack access to effective treatment, and we will change this.

SmartPatches enable effective, tech-enabled customer experiences, and our AI platform provides valuable insights for improved patient outcomes and the development of even better treatments. SmartPatches are affordable to manufacture and distribute, and easy to apply, resulting in greater access and market expansion. Panther is developing clinically validated products, the first of which launches in 2027.

The Opportunity:

This is a fall internship based in Pittsburgh, running from October through December, with the potential to extend beyond the initial internship period.

This internship is a hands-on opportunity to work directly on the development of Panther’s SmartPatch technology. You’ll make and test SmartPatches, evaluate how they perform in skin models, investigate failures, design controlled experiments, analyze data, and build custom testing tools in 3D CAD.

What makes this internship especially valuable is the breadth of experience you’ll gain across device development, materials, formulation, testing, and manufacturing. Rather than working on one small piece of a project, you’ll see how an early-stage medical technology is developed, tested, improved, and prepared for scale.

You’ll leave with practical experience in experimental design, device characterization, failure analysis, statistical analysis, CAD, technical documentation, and hands-on product development. This foundation is highly relevant for future careers in medical devices, biotech, pharmaceutical development, biomedical engineering, R&D, product development, and manufacturing engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct microneedle characterization studies using pre-clinical skin models, including donor skin

  • Perform failure mode analysis and material testing to inform critical design decisions, including stability, force, and optical testing

  • Fabricate dissolvable microneedle arrays for testing and characterization, applying working knowledge of Panther's formulation and manufacturing processes

  • Design and prototype custom test fixtures in 3D CAD to enable controlled, repeatable device characterization

  • Design experiments (DOE) to isolate test variables, and perform statistical analysis to support design decisions

  • Document work thoroughly and write technical reports summarizing findings and conclusions

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing or obtained a degree in Materials Science, Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field

  • Hands-on laboratory experience building, preparing, testing, or characterizing materials or devices, ideally involving biomaterials, polymers, medical devices, or drug delivery

  • Experience with mechanical or material testing, such as force, strength, stability, failure, penetration, or other material properties

  • Experience using test results to troubleshoot problems and improve a material, process, or device design

  • Experience with CAD, prototyping, experimental design, DOE, statistics, and/or analyzing test data to support engineering decisions

What We offer

  • Exposure to breakthrough health technology and insight into how next-generation drug delivery systems move from concept to product.

  • Real impact from day one. Work on projects that directly contribute to Panther’s microneedle array platform and product development.

  • Hands-on experience participating in the design, development, and testing of real technologies alongside senior engineers and scientists.

  • Meaningful ownership of discrete projects with clear outcomes and the opportunity to present your work to the team.

  • Startup-level responsibility within a small, fast-moving team where your ideas and contributions genuinely matter.

  • Work alongside a small group of thoughtful, curious people who care a lot about the mission. We collaborate closely, help each other out and work together.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Panther Life Sciences is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, citizenship, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

4cc74e487616.title: Data Analytics Engineering Intern
4cc74e487616.description_html:
Who We Are

Perchwell is the modern real estate listings platform built for agents to search smarter, collaborate better, and close deals faster. We are building the future of residential real estateʼs critical listings infrastructure: a platform where market  research and client collaboration converge. Our modern architecture enables continuous innovation at a pace legacy systems cannot match, with AI-powered features and mobile-first capabilities designed for how agents actually work. As consumer expectations and technology evolve, Perchwell remains focused on our core vision:  empowering real estate professionals with the most intelligent, data-driven, and connected platform in the industry.

Backed by leading venture capital firms including Lux Capital and Founders Fund, along with strategic partnerships with some of the country's top Multiple Listing Services (MLSs), Perchwell represents the first major new platform to enter the listings technology market in decades. This unique combination of institutional investment and deep industry alignment provides both the resources and market validation needed to transform the multi-trillion dollar residential real estate industry.

About this Role

Perchwell is expanding rapidly across the US, and every new MLS client brings a data source we haven't worked with before. Our Data Analytics Engineering team owns what happens next: understanding what is actually in that data, transforming it into our warehouse, and building the intelligence layer that sits on top of it. This summer, you'll work on that alongside our analytics engineers and data engineers, supporting both the MLS customers we serve today and the ones we're onboarding next.

What We’re Looking For

  • Rising seniors enrolled in a CS, data science, statistics, or other STEM degree program who are looking to intern at a fast paced SaaS company this summer.

  • Passionate problem solvers who thrive in fast moving environments.

  • Strong communicators and team players who can work cross functionally.

  • Careful thinkers who chase down a number that looks wrong instead of passing it along.

  • Eager learners who want to gain real world analytics engineering experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Understand New Data: Profile the data we are ingesting for new clients and partner with members of the broader engineering org to identify the most effective patterns for onboarding them into our standard reporting product.

  • Build and Ship: Extend the dbt models that transform raw MLS data into our warehouse, adding the tests and documentation the rest of the team depends on.

  • Build Intelligence: Strengthen the layer that sits on top of the warehouse, including metric definitions, semantic models, and the dashboards internal teams and customers rely on.

  • Own a Project: Take ownership of a summer project, making key modeling, tooling, and implementation decisions. Profiling and mapping a new non MLS data source is one strong candidate.

  • Collaborate and Learn: Partner with analytics engineers, data engineers, product managers, and customer facing teams to turn open questions into answers people can act on.

  • Deliver Impact: Work on scalable solutions from broadly defined problems and see your work in production.

Why This Internship? 

  • Dedicated Mentor: You'll work 1:1 with an experienced analytics engineer who will provide mentorship and support your growth.

  • Real Ownership: Over 10 weeks, early June to mid August, you will choose and lead your own project, making key decisions along the way.

  • Fully In Person Experience: This is a full time, in-office internship based at our beautiful New York City HQ in Soho. You'll work on site five days a week and collaborate closely with our team, gaining hands-on experience in a fast paced, learning oriented environment.

  • Showcase Your Work: At the end of the summer, present your project to our executive and data teams.

  • Work on Real Data: Beyond your project, you'll contribute to models, tests, and dashboards running in production against live customer data.

  • NYC Perks and Fun: From team dinners to museum trips, immerse yourself in the greatest city in the world while working with an awesome team.

Required for the Role

  • Working familiarity with RDBMS storage systems and SQL, including joins, aggregations, and CTEs. You don't need window functions yet, but you should want to learn them.

  • Curiosity about where data comes from and what it represents, not just how to query it.

  • Attention to detail and an instinct for when something doesn't add up.

  • Strong communication and problem solving abilities.

  • Excitement to learn, grow, and build.

Bonus Points for the Following

  • Coursework, projects, or prior internship experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery.

  • Exposure to dbt or another transformation framework.

  • An understanding of Python for working with data, such as pandas in coursework or personal projects.

  • Familiarity with Git and version controlled workflows.

  • Experience with a BI tool such as Looker, Tableau, Mode, or Metabase.

  • Any project, academic or personal, where you took messy source data and made it usable.

  • Demonstrated leadership skills developed during your college experience.

Internship Information

Internship Dates: June 7 - August 13, 2027

Application Deadline: Applications for this internship close on October 18, 2026, at 11 PM ET. Be sure to apply by the deadline to be considered! We will be reviewing all applications, so please take the time to submit a thoughtful application.

Offers: Internship offers will be extended by November 25, 2026.

Salary Information

$12,000 for 10 weeks (minus applicable taxes and withholdings)

Excited to launch your career with a tech startup in NYC? Apply now and build something meaningful with us in Summer 2027!

Note: Benefits package listed below is for reference only for those who later join Perchwell full-time.

Strong Benefits Package

  • Flexible PTO, plus 10 paid company holidays

  • 401K with a company match

  • Medical, dental, and vision plans

  • HSA and FSA options

  • Commuter benefits

  • Parental leave

  • Company-wide onsite or offsite each year

  • Beautiful office in Soho, Manhattan with a stocked kitchen, catered breakfast and lunch once per week, happy hours and meet-ups

 

Note: At this time, we are only considering candidates who are authorized to work in the U.S.
